text: How deep does the security around one card number really go?
prefix: How deep does the security around one card number really go?

text: Since Lesson 4, each lesson added one layer to the locked room: its doors, its frame, its proofs, its sealed numbers and its limits.
prefix: Since Lesson 4, each lesson added one layer to the locked room: its doors, its frame, its proofs, its sealed numbers and its limits.

text: This lesson follows one card number through every layer, and shows what each one stops.
prefix: This lesson follows one card number through every layer, and shows what each one stops.

text: Think of a bank vault.
prefix: Think of a bank vault.

text: There is a gate on the street.
prefix: There is a gate on the street.

text: A guard inside the door.
prefix: A guard inside the door.

text: Inner doors that open only with the right pass.
prefix: Inner doors that open only with the right pass.

text: A safe at the back, with keys no single person holds.
prefix: A safe at the back, with keys no single person holds.

text: And cameras everywhere.
prefix: And cameras everywhere.

text: No one layer is trusted to stop everything.
prefix: No one layer is trusted to stop everything.

text: Each layer assumes the one before it might fail.
prefix: Each layer assumes the one before it might fail.

text: That idea is called defence in depth.
prefix: That idea is called defence in depth.

text: The card zone is built the same way.
prefix: The card zone is built the same way.

text: Follow one card number through it, layer by layer.
prefix: Follow one card number through it, layer by layer.

text: Layer one is the gate: the payers' door.
prefix: Layer one is the gate: the payers' door.

text: The buyer's browser reaches the card zone only through this door.
prefix: The buyer's browser reaches the card zone only through this door.

text: It passes the card frame's few requests and answers not found to everything else.
prefix: It passes the card frame's few requests and answers not found to everything else.

text: It slows any one buyer who submits too fast.
prefix: It slows any one buyer who submits too fast.

text: Layer two is the glass at the counter: the card form's seals.
prefix: Layer two is the glass at the counter: the card form's seals.

text: The frame runs only its own two files.
prefix: The frame runs only its own two files.

text: A changed file does not run.
prefix: A changed file does not run.

text: A stranger's script is refused.
prefix: A stranger's script is refused.

text: Only the payment page its session names may hold it.
prefix: Only the payment page its session names may hold it.

text: This stops a skimmer copying the number as it is typed.
prefix: This stops a skimmer copying the number as it is typed.

text: Layer three is the guard: the fraud limits.
prefix: Layer three is the guard: the fraud limits.

text: Before any network is asked, the attempt is counted by the card's fingerprint, its first digits, the buyer's address and the shop.
prefix: Before any network is asked, the attempt is counted by the card's fingerprint, its first digits, the buyer's address and the shop.

text: Past the bank's chosen limits, the try is refused.
prefix: Past the bank's chosen limits, the try is refused.

text: This stops a thief testing stolen cards.
prefix: This stops a thief testing stolen cards.

text: Layer four is the safe: sealed numbers.
prefix: Layer four is the safe: sealed numbers.

text: Vault seals the number, and only the sealed value is kept.
prefix: Vault seals the number, and only the sealed value is kept.

text: The database refuses anything unsealed.
prefix: The database refuses anything unsealed.

text: The number is opened only to hand it to the card's network.
prefix: The number is opened only to hand it to the card's network.

text: This stops a stolen database or backup from leaking a single card.
prefix: This stops a stolen database or backup from leaking a single card.

text: Layer five is the inner doors: two proofs on every call.
prefix: Layer five is the inner doors: two proofs on every call.

text: When ecom asks to charge the card, it never sees the number.
prefix: When ecom asks to charge the card, it never sees the number.

text: It holds only the token.
prefix: It holds only the token.

text: Every call it makes carries two proofs: its certificate, and its token from the login server.
prefix: Every call it makes carries two proofs: its certificate, and its token from the login server.

text: Its role allows only the operations it needs.
prefix: Its role allows only the operations it needs.

text: This stops a stranger, or a caller overstepping, from using the card.
prefix: This stops a stranger, or a caller overstepping, from using the card.

text: Layer six is the cameras: logs that never show the number.
prefix: Layer six is the cameras: logs that never show the number.

text: Every use of card data is written down.
prefix: Every use of card data is written down.

text: Every log line cuts a card number down to its first six and last four digits.
prefix: Every log line cuts a card number down to its first six and last four digits.

text: Secrets in a log are starred out.
prefix: Secrets in a log are starred out.

text: Alerts carry no card data at all.
prefix: Alerts carry no card data at all.

text: This stops the record of what happened from becoming a leak.
prefix: This stops the record of what happened from becoming a leak.

text: Layer seven is the keyholders.
prefix: Layer seven is the keyholders.

text: Vault itself starts locked.
prefix: Vault itself starts locked.

text: To open it, three of five keyholders each bring their own share of the key.
prefix: To open it, three of five keyholders each bring their own share of the key.

text: No one person can open the safe alone.
prefix: No one person can open the safe alone.

text: This stops one insider from taking the keys.
prefix: This stops one insider from taking the keys.

text: Now watch the product, with one buyer.
prefix: Now watch the product, with one buyer.

text: The buyer opens the payment page.
prefix: The buyer opens the payment page.

text: The padlock shows.
prefix: The padlock shows.

text: The frame appears and groups the number in fours.
prefix: The frame appears and groups the number in fours.

text: The buyer presses "Send code", and a code arrives on their own phone.
prefix: The buyer presses "Send code", and a code arrives on their own phone.

text: They confirm, and the form says "Card accepted".
prefix: They confirm, and the form says "Card accepted".

text: The page shows only the masked line, the network and the bank.
prefix: The page shows only the masked line, the network and the bank.

text: ecom asks for the charge by token.
prefix: ecom asks for the charge by token.

text: The page says "Paid".
prefix: The page says "Paid".

text: Seven layers worked, and the buyer saw two fields and a button.
prefix: Seven layers worked, and the buyer saw two fields and a button.

text: On the bank's side, the team opens the card zone's logs for that payment.
prefix: On the bank's side, the team opens the card zone's logs for that payment.

text: They see the masked number, never the whole one.
prefix: They see the masked number, never the whole one.

text: They see who asked for what, and when.
prefix: They see who asked for what, and when.

text: Now Vault restarts.
prefix: Now Vault restarts.

text: It comes back locked.
prefix: It comes back locked.

text: The card form refuses new cards, and an alert says a service the card zone depends on is unavailable.
prefix: The card form refuses new cards, and an alert says a service the card zone depends on is unavailable.

text: It stays that way until the keyholders meet and open it.
prefix: It stays that way until the keyholders meet and open it.

text: What does this protect?
prefix: What does this protect?

text: Any single layer can fail one day.
prefix: Any single layer can fail one day.

text: A script slips past review.
prefix: A script slips past review.

text: A password leaks.
prefix: A password leaks.

text: A copy of the database escapes.
prefix: A copy of the database escapes.

text: When one layer fails, the next one still holds.
prefix: When one layer fails, the next one still holds.

text: That protects cardholders, shops and the bank.
prefix: That protects cardholders, shops and the bank.

text: Back to the vault.
prefix: Back to the vault.

text: Gate, guard, inner doors, safe, keyholders and cameras.
prefix: Gate, guard, inner doors, safe, keyholders and cameras.

text: A thief must beat every one of them.
prefix: A thief must beat every one of them.
